The county serves its parcels, as of 2026-11-10, from gis.hamiltontn.gov/server (ArcGIS Server 11.3), Parcels MapServer layer 0; layer 1 is the same parcels as labels. The Live_Parcels service on mapsdev.hamiltontn.gov that this record listed until 2026-11-10 answers HTTP 522 (origin timed out). Read 2026-11-10: 170,205 parcels, OWNERNAME1 on all of them, the owner's mailing street MASTNAME on 170,193, MACITY on 170,201, MAZIP on 170,052 and the site ADDRESS on 170,201; UPPER(OWNERNAME1) LIKE '%SMITH%' returns 2,339, the sample query's predicate. PBA_NUM is the full parcel book and account number with internal spaces ('033157K N 00900P000'); GISLINK is the trimmed parcel ID ('033157K N 00900'). MASTNUM is blank on every row because MASTNAME holds the whole mailing street line, so MASTNUM is not listed. maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination, Map, Query and Data, and the server reflects the caller's Origin for CORS. Exemption column, not listed: EXEMPTCODE is not a search field. Terms: the layer, its service and its item information carry no license or copyright text; the county's GIS page says parcels are provided by the Office of the Assessor of Property and that the data 'should be viewed only as a representation of reality'.

contact.department: City of Johnson City GIS Division (regional parcel layer covering Sullivan County)

counties.notes: Sullivan County, Tennessee (county seat Blountville; Kingsport and Bristol) has no county-run public REST parcel layer with owner names. Its parcels are carried on the City of Johnson City's regional ParcelPublishing/TaxParcels MapServer layer 0 (Tax Parcels), which also holds Washington, Carter, Unicoi and neighbouring counties. Filter with COUNTYNAME='Sullivan County' (78,958 of the layer's 183,538 rows on 2026-10-03); the plain value 'Sullivan' matches nothing. About 313 Sullivan parcels (GISLINK starting 082) carry a NULL or different COUNTYNAME and fall outside this scope, roughly 0.4 percent; COUNTY_ID=82 catches them but admits 314 rows from outside the county, so the name scope stays. The owner is OWNER (with OWNER2); the parcel ID is GISLINK (e.g. 082029B A 01600) with ID as the display form (029B A 016.00), and PARID is NULL for Sullivan rows. ADDRESS stores the street name first and the house number last (EXAMPLE RD 123), so search on a street word: a number-first LIKE ('%123 EXAMPLE RD%') returns nothing, and only 647 of 78,737 Sullivan addresses start with a digit, so the free tools' address auto-lookup will miss most Sullivan addresses until they retry number-last. The owner mailing address is MAILADDR with MAILCITY, STATE and ZIP. CARDURL links each parcel to the state's TPAD property card. CORS reflects the request Origin (Access-Control-Allow-Origin echoed back, credentials true); a request without an Origin gets no CORS header. maxRecordCount is 2000. License: restricted. The ArcGIS item's license text reads: "Read access only for all city staff. Delivered products are not to be resold by the purchaser for any reason and may not be reproduced without the written permission of the staff of the Johnson City GIS Division." The item and the REST endpoint are public, but the terms restrict resale and reproduction, so the atlas records only the query URL, stores no copy of the layer beyond the short-lived server cache every live query passes through, and serves this county by live query only; Leo reviewed and accepted that exposure on 2026-10-03. The data was last refreshed in October 2025. Sullivan County's own SULLIVAN service on ArcGIS Online has no owner field. The Tennessee Comptroller of the Treasury does publish a statewide property boundaries service (Tennessee_Property_Boundaries_Public_Use, 86 counties), but its description says it is not intended for commercial use, so it is not registered here; we asked the Comptroller for permission on 2026-11-01. Verified live 2026-10-03: owner SMITH returned rows (first row GISLINK 082029B A 01600, with a Kingsport mailing address).

Retired 2026-11-13, with the reason: the county's server answers our hosted servers with HTTP 403 every time, so we cannot serve this county. The server (gis.montgomerytn.gov, ArcGIS Server, behind Cloudflare) answers an ordinary home connection with HTTP 200 and the layer's metadata, and that was checked again on 2026-11-13 with a plain request. From the hosted servers this site's liveness probe and lookups run on, every probe on record failed with 403: 1,830 failures and no success. The home connection gets 200 with any User-Agent and the hosted servers get 403 every time, so the block follows where the request comes from, not what it says. A caller on its own machine can still reach the layer directly. Re-register the layer if the county stops blocking cloud hosts. Prior record (Montgomery County, Tennessee; Clarksville; FIPS 47125; verified 2026-10-14): PublicParcels MapServer layer 0 on the Assessor of Property's public GIS server, 99,941 rows on 2026-11-10; registered fields ParcelNo (e.g. 066E A 00600 000), GISLINK (063066E A 00600), PropertyAddress and PropertyCity only. On 2026-11-10 the layer also carried Owner1, Owner2, MailingAddress, MailCity, MailState and MailZip, which the record never listed. Rows are one per building card, not one per parcel, so a parcel with several buildings repeats its parcel id and situs. The layer's wkid is 102736 (Tennessee State Plane, US feet; latestWkid 2274); maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination. No license or terms are posted on the layer, its service, its item information or the assessor's pages.

coverage.summary: Montgomery County's GIS server answers every request from our hosted servers with HTTP 403 (it blocks cloud hosts) though it answers a home connection, so we can't serve it and don't index it. Use the Assessor's GIS page, or request it and we'll tell you if that changes.

The county's own ArcGIS server (arcgis2.williamson-tn.org) publishes two parcel copies, neither current: IDT/Historical_Parcels02162003, a 2003 copy, and IDT/DataPull, whose Parcels layers (4 and 10) carry owner names and mailing addresses for 100,369 parcels but whose newest transfer date is 2022-11-12. The county's online map names a parcel service (Williamson_Map_v10_LATEST1) that the public server does not run. This atlas uses neither copy, because owners would be four or more years out of date. contact.department: City of Murfreesboro GIS Department (publisher of this county-wide parcel layer); CAMA records come from the Rutherford County Property Assessor

counties.notes: Rutherford County, Tennessee (county seat Murfreesboro; FIPS 47149). The publisher is the City of Murfreesboro, not the County Property Assessor. The county runs no parcel REST service we found, and the Tennessee Comptroller's statewide parcel data leaves Rutherford out (it is one of nine counties the Comptroller excludes). The city's ArcGIS Online organization serves the item 'Parcel Data' (service item f3ec2bfab6d745eaa81498c5c0406d1b, last edited 2026-11-04), described as parcel and special-interest property data for Rutherford County; layer 1, 'Parcels', is the one registered. Layer 0, 'Special Interest', carries the same CAMA columns and is not registered. The layer carries the whole county, not the city alone: 123,334 parcels on 2026-11-22, every row with COUNTY = '075', and LocationCity spans Murfreesboro 72,367, Smyrna 21,603, La Vergne 12,612, Christiana 5,246, Rockvale 3,234, Lascassas 2,368, Eagleville 1,471, Bell Buckle 909, Readyville 892, Milton 586, Mount Juliet 541, Nolensville 541, Arrington 273, College Grove 198, Unionville 80, Lebanon 34, Shelbyville 17, Auburntown 1 and 22 rows labelled Rutherford County. The owner is Owner1, with Owner2 and Owner3 for further owners; the owner mailing address is MailingAddress (street line), MailingAddress2, MailingCity, MailingState and MailingZipCode. Owner1, MailingAddress, MailingCity and MailingZipCode are non-blank on 122,995 rows (the other 339 parcels carry no CAMA record), MailingState on 122,992, and MailingAddress2 carries a second line on 201; Owner2 is filled on 58,790 and Owner3 on 5,575. The site address is FormattedLocation (house number and street, no city; LocationCity and LocationZip hold the rest), non-blank on the same 122,995 rows; STREETADDRESS is filled on only 48 rows and is not used. The parcel id is ParcelID (digits, letters and dashes in a map-group-parcel form; 122,995 rows), with PropertyID as the numeric CAMA id and GISLINK and GISKEY as alternate forms. Verified 2026-11-22 with Origin https://urbankitstudio.com: an exact ParcelID query returns 1 row, an exact PropertyID query 1, Owner1 LIKE %SMITH% counts 1,205 rows, FormattedLocation LIKE %MAIN% 403, and a point query on a parcel's centroid returns that parcel. maxRecordCount 2000 with pagination (an OBJECTID-ordered second page of three follows the first without overlap); capabilities Query and Extract; CORS answers Access-Control-Allow-Origin * on the layer and on queries. Native spatial reference: Tennessee State Plane feet (WKID 2274), so a point query passes inSR=4326. Buffer distance: the server converts a point buffer's distance from metres to feet and then reads the feet as metres, so distance=30 with units=esriSRUnit_Meter searches about 98.4 m. Measured 2026-11-22 against polygon circles sent in its place: on 20 parcel centroids the 30 m buffer returned a median of 23.5 parcels against 3.5 for a true 30 m circle, and on 8 others it matched a 98.4 m circle to within one parcel at every point. Send a polygon when the distance matters. Currency: the newest SaleDate is 2026-10-30 and the newest MODIFYDATE 2026-11-03; the service says it was last edited 2026-11-04. Terms: no license is published. The item's license and access fields are blank, and the only terms found are the City of Murfreesboro GIS data disclaimer shown on its PublicGIS viewer (maps.murfreesborotn.gov/PublicGIS), which says the data is developed from information deemed reliable, that by accepting it the user absolves the City from any liability related to its use for any purpose, that it is not a legal conveyance or boundary survey, and that it may change without notice. That is a warranty and liability disclaimer: it grants no license and restricts no use, so the license is recorded as unknown and is not called open data. The disclaimer text is read at the licenseUrl. We have not asked the City GIS Department about commercial or paid use; because the publisher is the city and not the Assessor, a courtesy question to it is open. Informational only and not a survey: verify with the Rutherford County Property Assessor (https://secured.rutherfordcountytn.gov/OFS/WP/Home).

counties.notes: Carter County, Tennessee (county seat Elizabethton; FIPS 47019) was searched on the site in November 2026. The county runs no public parcel REST layer of its own (ArcGIS Online searches on 2026-11-21 found only third-party copies). Its parcels are carried on the City of Johnson City's regional ParcelPublishing/TaxParcels MapServer layer 0, the same layer the Sullivan County record uses, which also holds Washington, Sullivan and Unicoi counties. Filter with COUNTYNAME='Carter County' (32,108 rows on 2026-11-21, 31,951 with an owner); 45 parcels whose GISLINK starts 010 carry a NULL or different COUNTYNAME and fall outside this scope (about 0.1 percent), and COUNTY_ID=10 returns a wider 32,189, so the name scope stays. The owner is OWNER (with OWNER2); the parcel ID is GISLINK (e.g. 010034N B 00800) with ID as the display form (034N B 008.00). ADDRESS stores the street name first and the house number last, so search on a street word. The owner mailing address is MAILADDR (31,963 rows) with MAILCITY, STATE and ZIP. CARDURL links each parcel to the state's TPAD property card. CORS reflects the request Origin. maxRecordCount 2000. Currency: the newest last_edited_date on Carter rows is 2026-09-18. License: restricted. The service's license text reads: "Read access only for all city staff. Delivered products are not to be resold by the purchaser for any reason and may not be reproduced without the written permission of the staff of the Johnson City GIS Division." As for Sullivan, the atlas records only the query URL and serves the county by live query only, and paid lookups are off. The Tennessee Comptroller of the Treasury maintains Carter's property maps (Carter is not one of the nine counties it excludes) and its statewide 'Tennessee Property Boundaries Public Use' layer holds 32,019 Carter parcels (COUNTY_ID=10), but that service says it is not intended for commercial use; the Comptroller's weekly shapefile, which its Parcel Data page says any company may use 'including consumption in a commercial application/software', is the route for paid lookups once hosted (https://comptroller.tn.gov/office-functions/pa/gisredistricting/redistricting-and-land-use-maps/parcel-data.html; the Comptroller's statewide answer of 2026-11-04). Until then paid lookups stay off under the Johnson City license; we have not asked the City or the county for permission. Verified 2026-11-21: a scoped count, an owner LIKE query (429 rows for %SMITH%), an ADDRESS LIKE query (126 rows for MAIN) and an exact GISLINK round trip.
